Single-cell depth and B-allele fraction tracks

Source: R/plot_cells.R
cell_tracks.Rd

Builds, for a set of cells, the data behind plot_cell_tracks():

  • depth: per cell and window the log2 ratio log2((x + 0.5) / (e + 0.5)) of the features' 1 Mb windows and of agg windows. As in clone_profiles(), relative to the reference pool when it has at least min_ref cells and centred on the cell's autosomal median, so the track is on the scale of the clone segments. The copy-number baseline (base, the copy number at log2 0) is the chromosome's ploidy when the depth is relative to other cells of the sample (a reference pool, or the features' celltype / loo depth, normal mode's), else 2 (model depth: a male chrX sits at log2 -1). Without a depth method in the features' notes, normal-mode results take the ploidy. When the result's clones has a baseline column (the clone's ploidy baseline B, with absolute copy-number states), base is scaled by B / 2 for the cell's clone (NA or no column: 2, i.e. unchanged).

  • baf: per cell and agg window the oriented haplotype-A fraction nA / (nA + nB) of the cell's molecule votes. Phase blocks are oriented with orient_blocks() (ties dropped) by a leave-one-out pseudobulk: of the cell's clone (orient = "clone", the confirmation's orientation) or of all cells ("pseudobulk"); "none" keeps the phased haplotypes as they are (meaningful with chromosome-wide phasing). "auto": "clone" in tumour mode, "none" in normal mode with chromosome-wide phasing, else "pseudobulk".

  • fit: the fitted segments of each cell. Tumour mode: the segments of the cell's clone, with source confirmed (the cell's call has source confirmed), inherited (a reportable call with source inherited: the clone's segment carried to the cell without its own confirmation), or clone (neutral, or a clone segment without a reportable call in the cell). Normal mode: the cell's events (nominal states of their labels: loss 1:0, cnloh 2:0, gain 2:1, gain_as 3:0, amp 3:1, del 0:0; on a haploid chromosome loss 0:0, gain 2:0, amp 3:0) on a neutral baseline; events without coordinates take those of their top_region, else the whole chromosome. Expected log2 c * log2(max(cn, 0.2) / base) (c the clone's depth contrast, 1 in normal mode or when the result has none) and expected major fraction 0.5 + a * (f - 0.5) (a the clone's orientation attenuation, likewise 1). Haploid chromosomes are the chrX / chrY rows with allelic_ok FALSE in the result's regions; a result without that column is treated as diploid throughout.

  • meta: one row per cell (clone, posterior, assigned, n_frag, number of confirmed / inherited segments).

  • genome: chromosome offsets for a concatenated genome axis.

Usage

cell_tracks(
  features,
  result,
  cells = NULL,
  agg = 5e+06,
  orient = c("auto", "clone", "pseudobulk", "none"),
  min_ref = 30
)

Arguments

features

features object (cell_features()) with win, votes and atoms

result

caller result (call_scn() or read_scphasedcn())

cells

cells to return (default: the result's cells that are in the features)

agg

size of the aggregated windows (bp; depth points and BAF)

orient

phase-block orientation of the BAF (see Details)

min_ref

minimal reference pool size to reference the depth to the pool

Value

list of data.tables depth (cell, chrom, start, end, size, log2), baf (cell, chrom, start, end, nA, n_hap, baf, se), fit (cell, clone, chrom, start, end, state, cn, label, source, ploidy, base, log2_exp, f_exp), meta and genome; attributes orient and mode
